source.name: Food Inspections - Chicago Department of Public Health (City of Chicago Data Portal)
source.api: https://data.cityofchicago.org/resource/4ijn-s7e5.json (anonymous Socrata API, no key, paged by inspection_id)
source.licence: LicenseRef-CityOfChicago-DataTermsOfUse - the portal's own Data Terms of Use (Socrata licenseId SEE_TERMS_OF_USE); operator-accepted portal-terms posture decided 2026-09-28, reusing the 2026-09-26 DOAH acceptance

note: 40 per-code configs ship as 40 separate task instances (code_01, code_02, ... code_60), mirroring the per-level pattern of the noaa-tide-flooding and msha-enforcement-citations releases; the joint multi-label matrix is labels.csv at the dataset root and is documented rather than gated. The config list and every digest are recorded in candidates/chicago-food-inspections/baseline/expected_artifact.json, which is the authority the manifest is generated from.
